ins = 0

    length = 0

        if s[i] == '_':
            if length > 0:
                ins += 1
            length = 0
        else:
            length += 1
        i += 1

        ins += 1
    return i + 1

    length = 0
    i = 0

        c = s[i]
        if c == '(':

                lon = max(lon, length)
            length = 0
            i = process_inside(s, i + 1)
        else:
            if c == '_':
                if length > 0:
                    lon = max(lon, length)
                length = 0
            else:
                length += 1
            i += 1
    if length > 0:
        lon = max(lon, length)
    print(f"{lon} {ins}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
